scope: Two launches of the exact self-contained apphost against one disposable local SQLite data directory. Windows Service Manager, real equipment, and real hypervisors were outside the fixture.
checks: simulated cabinet, devices, node and VMs are explicitly identified and do not duplicate on bootstrapping
simulated browser terminal applies CR, LF, CRLF, BS and DEL before saving a real startup configuration
apphost restart preserves node configuration and clock offset, VM power, resource utilization and account assignments
process exit clears the terminal lease, and reopening or reclaiming the connection retains its saved settings
